name: Listen Notes
tagline: Podcast search and directory API for discovery, episodes, and analytics
description: Listen Notes provides a podcast search and directory API with endpoints for searching podcasts and episodes, browsing top charts, retrieving podcast and episode details, fetching best podcasts by genre, and accessing related content. It is commonly used to power podcast apps, recommendation features, and media research tools.

auth.details: API key via X-ListenAPI-Key header; self-serve signup on listennotes.com

use_cases: search podcasts and episodes by keyword
get podcast details and episode lists
browse top charts by genre or region
